experience.title: Experience
experience.introduction: Building and maintaining business applications, from investigating production issues to delivering changes.

result.description: reduction in memory consumption in an enterprise web application.

highlights: Investigated and resolved critical production incidents, working directly with application users.
Implemented bulk invoice submission to Spain's Tax Agency to reduce manual work.
Build changes from business requirements and contribute to testing and production maintenance.
Developed and maintained custom ERP solutions with C#/.NET, WPF and SQL Server.
Worked directly with clients to clarify requirements and resolve issues.
Improved a client ERP application's performance by more than 20% through targeted optimisations.
Built REST APIs and contributed to migrating legacy .NET software towards .NET 6 microservices and integrating two previously separate applications.
